# Nerfies template assets

These files were copied from the local checkout of
[`nerfies/nerfies.github.io`](https://github.com/nerfies/nerfies.github.io)
at commit `657409a62d59a93163872c0e4921cf651b987810`:

- `css/index.css` — original Nerfies website stylesheet, licensed under
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
- `css/bulma.min.css` — Bulma v0.9.1, licensed under the MIT License.

The SRL-MPC-specific styles remain in `docs/styles.css`. Nerfies media,
analytics, interpolation data, jQuery, and project-specific JavaScript are not
included.
